name: Entner-Doudoroff Pathway (Semi-Phosphorylative, Alternative)
notes: Alternative semi-phosphorylative Entner-Doudoroff pathway (M00633): gluconate => G3P. Found specifically in crenarchaeota (Sulfolobus, Thermoplasma, Thermococcales). Similar to M00308 but uses alternative enzymes: kdgK2 (K18126) for kinase step and kdpgA (K11395) for aldolase. Branches with non-phosphorylative ED (M00309) at gnaD. Diagnostic feature: combination of kdgK2 phosphorylation with kdpgA aldolase. Common in thermophilic archaea.

nodes.name: gluconate dehydratase
nodes.notes: Dehydrates gluconate to KDG; shared with non-phosphorylative ED (M00309)

nodes.name: 2-dehydro-3-deoxygluconokinase
nodes.notes: Alternative kinase for semi-phosphorylative ED; phosphorylates KDG to KDPG. Specific to archaeal variant M00633.

nodes.name: 2-dehydro-3-deoxyphosphogluconate aldolase
nodes.notes: Alternative KDPG aldolase for M00633; cleaves KDPG to G3P + pyruvate. Different EC number than K01625.

nodes.name: glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (NADP+)
nodes.notes: Non-phosphorylating GAPDH; directly converts G3P to 3-phosphoglycerate using NADP+ without ATP generation. Common in archaea.

edges.notes: Phosphorylation step - diagnostic for semi-phosphorylative ED

scoring.notes: Core pathway (steps 1-3) required for detection. Downstream processing (step 4) optional. Diagnostic markers (kdgK2 + kdpgA) distinguish M00633 from M00308 (which uses kdgK + eda) and from non-phosphorylative M00309 (which lacks phosphorylation step entirely).
